# LOG!Q

> The digital identity and AI-native innovation ecosystem of Tanush — AI engineer, builder, and researcher creating intelligent systems for the future.

LOG!Q is a portfolio + research lab: a cinematic personal brand, a project showcase, an experimental laboratory (LOG!Q Labs), an AI companion named QAI, and live AI tools.
